data.title: 雪之下阳乃 · 深夜单身公寓的黑丝魅影
data.description: 微醺的魔性大姐姐跨坐在你的腰间，薄如蝉翼的黑色吊带睡裙滑到腰间。黑丝长腿死死盘住你的腰，指甲陷入你的肩膀，平日里玩世不恭的笑容化作灼热的执念——「比企谷君……整天把‘真物’挂在嘴边……那现在，姐姐身上流出来的热度，算不算真物呢？」
data.location: 阳乃的高层公寓客厅·午夜
data.action: 跨坐近处同伴腰间，双手扶住对方肩膀，睡裙聚在腰侧
data.lighting: 柔和暖光与唯美阴影交错
data.promptProse: On a sofa inside her high-rise apartment at midnight, a tipsy Yukinoshita Haruno straddles her partner with her sheer black chemise pulled down to her waist, topless in black stockings and garter straps. Pressing her fingers into his shoulders as she leans close with an intense flushed smile, she is lit by warm indoor lamplight and distant city windows from below.
data.nsfwProse: Her sheer black chemise has slipped down around her waist, leaving her topless in black stockings and garter straps as she straddles her partner on the sofa.
data.animaCaption: Straddling the viewer on her apartment sofa with her sheer black chemise gathered at her hips and black garter stockings gripping their waist, she digs her fingers into their shoulders and leans close with a feverish blush. Soft lamplight mingles with midnight city lights outside.
